fusions.name: Butt-Strike Tremor
fusions.desc: Slams the butt of the shaft into the ground, which deals 28 earth damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. It ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Flint That Flakes
fusions.desc: A thrust with a flint head that deals 8 damage and leaves flakes in the wound, making the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Bedrock Stance
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Hill Under the Heel
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 30%, you gain a shield worth 20% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
